(1) we can obtain an analytical approximation to the Gaussian process predictive distribution, which is valid in the limit of large number of observations; (2) the analytical approximation is accurate for small and moderate numbers of observations; (3) the analytical approximation allows to obtain an efficient implementation of the multi-step ahead forecasting algorithm; (4) the proposed algorithm is able to capture the uncertainty of the intermediate regressor values; (5) the proposed algorithm can be easily implemented in a distributed computing environment,
